svg.desc: Ain Shams University Medical City LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Higher Education COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2018 1.1 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2018 for the Egyptian Ministry of Higher Education, this 1.1 billion EGP project involved the comprehensive design and development of Ain Shams University Medical City in Cairo. It included urban design, site coordination, detailed designs for main axes, facades, squares, gates, and walls, the restoration of Demerdash Palace, and construction of a new ER building and multi-storey garage.
